title: ELMES+: Automated Construction of Fine-Grained Evaluation Rubrics for Large Language Models in Long-Tail Educational Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the evaluation scores an LLM judge assigns to its own generated outputs against the scores assigned by human experts and other independent LLM judges to detect instances of disproportionately high self-ratings.

bias_targets.target: Evaluator scoring bias (Mean-score and Variance bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the mean-score deviations, variance deviations, and systematic additive biases (e.g., overly lenient or stringent scoring patterns) of different LLM judges compared to human expert baseline evaluations.
